summary: One of the first chatbots. Its best-known script, DOCTOR, played a therapist who turned your own words back into questions. It understood nothing, yet people confided in it, which troubled its maker and gave a name to the “ELIZA effect”: our habit of seeing a mind in a machine that only matches patterns.

events.note: Weizenbaum starts work on it at MIT.

note: A research program with no product life and no official end; it survives in copies and re-creations.
